notes.title: Voice Chat Overhauled!
notes.content:
We have completely reworked the voice chat from the ground up. 
The quality of the voice chat should now be massively improved.

Thanks to Julian Todd and his two-voip plugin.

notes.title: Deck Recommendation
notes.content:
Added new Feature: In the host screen you will now see recommended Steam Workshop Decks, when clicking on the "+" button!

Voice Chat is an ongoing Issue we are still trying to fix!

notes.title: Huge Performance Improvement!
notes.content:
We found an issue that was massively decreasing FPS and fixed it.

Most Players should see an improvement of 50-100% in FPS.

notes.title: Technical fixes and microphone improvements
notes.content:
Reworking of peer to peer functionality for some devices, microphone quality largely improved.
If you are experiencing crashes upon launching the game, make sure you graphics card drivers are up to date and support Vulkan.
If you are experiencing crashes during gameplay, feel free to start a discussion and link the latest log created in '\AppData\Roaming\Godot\app_userdata\Pic-ME\logs'

notes.title: Chinese/Japanese added
notes.content: Added Chinese and Japanese Support to the game

notes.title: Russian Language Fixed
notes.content: Fixed Issues with the russian language!
